rules.statement: State lands cannot be alienated on long lease without following the proper procedure; failure to do so is a violation of the Public Trust doctrine.
rules.supporting_quote: State lands cannot be alienated on long lease without following the proper procedure; failure to do so is a violation of the Public Trust doctrine – vide Sugathapala Mendis v. Chandrika Kumaratunga [2008] 2 Sri LR 339 at 352.
